name: Aether Slash / actual attack action pitch does not earn non attack pitch arcane
printed_text: When this attacks, if a non-attack action card was pitched to play this, deal 1 arcane damage to any target.

name: Art of the Dragon: Fire / non draconic card does not earn draconic attack damage
printed_text: When this attacks, if it is Draconic, deal 2 damage to any target.

name: Astral Strike / no lightning flow destroy does not earn draw power or go again choice
printed_text:
When this attacks, if you've destroyed a Lightning Flow this turn, choose 1;
- Draw a card.
- This gets +2{p}.
- This gets **go again**.
